source.title: Appointment of New Senior Delegates (October 2019)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have two new Senior Delegates:

- Leow Yi Jun - Asia Southeast
- Serhii Koksharov - Central Eurasia
<!-- break -->
They were selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of [Motion 9.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

Their terms as Senior Delegate are effective as of October 1, 2019.

The application documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FXmw3EErv9qBf3H-C1oZqe2Pl0ahuItF?usp=sharing) if you are interested in viewing them. 

An application was also received from Ilya Tsiareshka for the Central Eurasia Senior Delegate position. We want to thank all applicants for their willingness in helping the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than they currently do. Good luck to Yi Jun and Serhii in their new roles!

translation.title: 新任高级代表公告（2019 年 10 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，两位新高级代表已获任命：

- Leow Yi Jun——东南亚
- Serhii Koksharov——欧亚中部

<!-- break -->

WCA 董事会依照关于高级代表的[决议 9.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节，通过内部投票选定了他们。

两人的高级代表任期自 2019 年 10 月 1 日起生效。

申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FXmw3EErv9qBf3H-C1oZqe2Pl0ahuItF?usp=sharing)查看。

Ilya Tsiareshka 也提交了欧亚中部高级代表的申请。感谢所有申请人愿意在现有工作的基础上，继续为 WCA 和速拧社区多出一份力。祝 Yi Jun 和 Serhii 在新岗位上一切顺利！
